notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/a45f17989336d488faddd5be3b68b2009d15eaf1.png[/img]

It's been a year since you delved into the dark fairy tale driven world of BLACKTAIL and became the guardian of the woods or… the terror nightmares are made of. Or perhaps you haven't decided your fate just yet? If you are one of those who haven't ventured into the world of BLACKTAIL, we’ve prepared a [b]special anniversary discount[/b] just for you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532690/BLACKTAIL/

A full year is also a fantastic time for a small recap. Especially since during that time we've received more than [b]10 nominations and awards[/b]! While our primary focus is on you, our community, we're thrilled to have been recognized by the game development industry. To have collected such prestigious awards for narrative work, audio, design, and performance is exhilarating. It feels nice inside to be acknowledged by numerous juries across various categories. 

Awards are the cherry on top of how our game resonates with our community. Numbers and reviews speak for themselves - most of you have basically fallen in love with our game, which is our dream come true.

Let's spend a bit more time in the magical Slavic woods. Enjoy the game, our Behind-the-Scenes deep-dive video, and the OST, which is available here via Steam and all good music streaming services. Embrace the mystical aura of the year's end and spend it with Yaga and The Black Cat.

[previewyoutube=8obz0zjL3pk;full][/previewyoutube]

And finally, to all of you reading this message, all of us at THE PARASIGHT want to wish you a peaceful conclusion to this year and an even better one to follow. We want to also express our gratitude for your continued support. The significance of the Steam reviews, social media interactions, and e-mails cannot be overstated, as they serve as a tremendous source of motivation for us to shape an even more thrilling experience. So from the bottom of our collective heart, thank you for being the best community of players any developer could ever ask for. 
 
Have a safe and happy break, and until next time, 
 
[i]Yours[/i],
 
 THE PARASIGHT team

notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Or should we say "Hi witches” as many of you have already dived into BLACKTAIL’s world ;)

A huge thanks for your ongoing support, sending feedback and writing reviews. 
BLACKTAIL is trending on Steam which is solely due to you - we couldn’t ask for a more committed community.

[list]
[*] The first [b]HOTFIX[/b] is now live on Steam. 
We have addressed certain concerns and issues which were possible to implement at this point in time. 
[*] We’ve also prepared the [b]Witchcraft Starter Kit[/b] down below. We wouldn’t want you to be an easy target in BLACKTAIL’s woods.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/ee245c6f0cf739d634ff3e7e49e028509075f624.jpg[/img]

HOTFIX notes:

[olist]
[*] Various bug fixes, crashes and potential blockers.
[*] Yaga's starting Vitality has been increased.
[*] Additional tutorial reminders for the controls and movement. 
[*] New Game+ tweaks. You now get bonus resources - teeth and shelloks - and carry over your Map, Collectibles, and Almanac entries.
[*] Hostile Mushrooms have been balanced.
[*] Visual adjustments have been made to enhance visibility to certain areas.
[*]  Sticky crosshair range increased.
[*] HDR issues fixed.
[/olist]

We’re gathering your feedback and preparing a more detailed patch for January, to help improve your BLACKTAIL experience. Until then, wishing you all a well-deserved rest, stay safe, and see you on the other side witches!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/ecd319ed7571ad4ca34e46c4ac49f7d68acb296d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Don’t forget to dash[/h3]
The first skill you get is a crucial one. [b]Dashing[/b] - [u]Mouse button 3 or 5 (RB)[/u] - at just the right moment should keep you from harm, provided your timing is on point. It’s also the best way to enhance your traversal.

[h3]Use Hokuses. Often[/h3]
[u]Press [F] (R3)[/u] to use [b]Deflect Hokus[/b] for pushing back enemies and breaking obstacles. [u]Hold [F] (R3)[/u] to perform a [b]Sunlight/Leech Hokus[/b] - linked to your current moral stance.

[h3]The Broom is your best friend in combat![/h3]
[b]The Broom[/b] not only acts as a decoy by luring enemies, but it also grows ever more powerful the more defined Yaga’s character becomes. Comes in handy also during boss fights. [u]Press [Q] (Y)[/u] once you have this ability.

[h3]Special treats[/h3]
By combining the power of [b]The Gauntlet[/b] with her marksmanship prowess, Yaga can perform maneuvers far beyond any ordinary hunter’s array. [u]Hold LMB (RT)[/u] and then [u]press [F] (R3)[/u] to perform the [b]Special treat[/b].

[h3]Save haven[/h3]
Use [b]Shrines[/b] often, there is also an auto-save system to keep your progress in crucial moments.

[h3]Berries[/h3]
[b]Berries[/b] have healing properties and grow in various places, including boss areas.

[h3]The Hut[/h3]
Don’t hesitate to use Cataportation and return to [b]The Hut[/b]. Brew [b]Elixirs[/b], unlock new [b]Skills[/b], and activate your [b]Hexes[/b]. Take a stroll through the yard, make it a home for your [b]Toads[/b]. Get into power and ease yourself into this big adventure!

[h3]Explore the world[/h3]
There’s plenty to explore in BLACKTAIL. Roam the world and keep your eyes wide open. [u]Hold [R] (B)[/u] to hide the bow and move faster. Use the [b]Map[/b] and [b]Compass[/b], switch between the main quest and side quests in your [b]Journal[/b] - look for [b]Resources[/b] and [b]Lost Pages[/b].

[h3]Adventure or Story mode?[/h3]
You can change the difficulty level during your journey. The initial choice is not definitive, adjust it to your preferences on the fly. Remember to have fun :)


Yours,
The PARASIGHT Team

notes.title: The voices of BLACKTAIL revealed!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We’re thrilled to share with you the[b] talented cast[/b] that bring to life the iconic characters of [b]BLACKTAIL[/b].

Read the combined interview with [b]Valerie Rose Lohman[/b] (known from What Remains of Edith Finch, Wolfenstein Youngblood) and [b]Avalon Penrose[/b] (known for playing Megaera in Hades), BLACKTAIL’s Yaga and The Voice respectively and watch [b]Nergal [/b](Behemoth’s front man) step into The Black Cat’s role.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/9e8549227773f4f8ae41aebd7ba3b901c818c14f.png[/img]

[b]Could you tell us a bit about yourself and your roles?[/b]

[b]A:[/b] I am Avalon Penrose, I’m mostly known for my role as Megaera in the game Hades. There are a lot of similarities between Megaera and my character of the Voice in BLACKTAIL. They’re both strong, powerful, dominant women. You don’t see a lot of female characters in the media that are portrayed with this kind of harshness and bluntness. Megaera, however, has an undertone of love for her partner, who she’s always going to love in her deepest soul. The Voice has a different kind of love, for the person that she’s always in the mind of. It’s even harder to distinguish.

[b]V:[/b] My name is Valerie Rose Lohman; most people know me from the video game What Remains of Edith Finch and I’m also in Wolfenstein: Youngblood and Wylde Flowers. There’s a big commonality between BLACKTAIL and some of my previous works in that I play a lot of women who are finding themselves. Edith, in particular, is so lost, and I see so much of that in Yaga. They’re both discovering so much about their identity, their family, where they come from… There’s so much exploration, but Edith doesn’t have the type of outside forces that Yaga – who’s very ostracised – has to deal with.


[b]How was it for you to invest yourselves in this fairy-tale driven world?[/b]

[b]V: [/b]I grew up loving fairy tales, especially their dark versions. I remember The Brothers Grimm and Sleepy Hollow as spooky, fairy-tale driven films with dark legends. I also knew the tales of Baba Yaga. I love the sweet, fun versions of fairy tales, I’m a big Disney fan. But I also love the warnings and lessons that are in the darker versions of these tales. So getting to dive into this was such a treat. I loved piecing together the different influences from fairy tales, myths and legends that were sprinkled throughout. It was inspiring to know that there’s all this magic and talking creatures… Yes the game is grounded and real, but there’s also this eerie playfulness, which was so much fun to perform.

[b]A:[/b] It was a joy to play a character in this world. I love rough and gritty tales, the dark side which didn’t make it to Disney movies. All this magic can exist but at the same time, you can’t escape the parts of human life that are morality and all these challenges, which make for such an intense and all-consuming game. I love the juxtaposition of these moral battles over this beautiful fairy tale world with unbelievable graphics and gorgeous character design.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/5b1cb538b4b8ef901c1cd8a3146aff6c322c1b72.png[/img]

[b]How does BLACKTAIL compare to the way you imagined the myth of Baba Yaga?
[/b]
[b]V:[/b] My first ever learning of Baba Yaga was when I was very little, in a spinoff of the animated movie Anastasia. It was this image of a very old scary witch with her very scary, iconic tree. We never got a backstory from her in that film. Any time I've consumed media that pertains to Baba Yaga, she's elusive. She's this kind of mysterious villain, sometimes morally grey. I was really excited to have the chance to finally dive into this.

[b]A:[/b] I knew nothing about Baba Yaga. When I began working on BLACKTAIL, I did a ton of reading to learn about her. I found that a lot of what I read was different from what we experienced in recording this game. It’s really cool because, just as Valerie said, it gives you such a unique perspective on someone who in folklore may be regarded as only evil.



[b]How did you find your voice for the role?[/b]

[b]A:[/b] It was all about tapping into the darker sides of my own personality. You don't only see the cruelty and the mystery of the Voice at first. But there’s more to it than just being the bad guy. I had to authentically connect with the sides of myself that have been cruel or mean at times. I would sometimes just take a few moments and try to get a little angry and see what voices came out of me, or think of times when I felt anger and was negative and nasty to people. I tried to channel all of that, because I didn't want my voice to sound inauthentic; I wanted it to sound driven by true emotion.

[b]V:[/b] For me, it was a lot about finding Yaga’s rage. One of my audition scripts was filled with so many levels of rage, so I immediately knew this was the ride I was going on. We all have rage, anger. All these things inside of us, that we don’t let out because we live in a society and we must be pleasant and kind. But it was tapping into that unfiltered rage. I've not been kicked out of a mediaeval village for being accused of being a witch, but we all deal with loss and grief and people misunderstanding us. So it was about finding that from a really truthful place. I also added a layer with remembering when I was 16, my emotional volatility, still finding myself, feeling embarrassed, scared and lost at this teetering age.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/ddc941a1314b3bcb07130d394689465d33bdfe0c.png[/img]

[b]What did you like about playing the roles of Yaga (Valerie) and of the Voice (Avalon)? [/b]

[b]V:[/b] I just really loved the highs and lows and the layers to find with Yaga. She is so multifaceted, and it was a joy to explore it.

[b]A:[/b] I loved finding the mystery of the voice which unfolds throughout the duration of the game, seeing this mystery begin to clarify.


[b]The gaming community loved your performance since BLACKTAIL’s very first demo. Have you kept in touch with them and have they inspired your approach?[/b]

[b]V:[/b] I have been watching from afar, because we were not yet able to share that we're a part of it. But I've been keeping tabs on the different playthroughs which came out. I’m super stoked to finally be able to interact with such an invested community.

[b]A:[/b] I was also watching from afar. For the most part everyone was very positive and received the voices very well. At the same time, there were comments on the harshness of the American voice and all that. It didn't necessarily lead me to change my performance, which I wanted to be true all the way through. But it gave me some context on the effect it was having on people. The Voice is not a comforting presence. It's supposed to make you feel a little uncomfortable, a little on edge. So I liked that people received it as harsh, because that's part of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/961fbc122f1a8cb68fec158df79df267aec769e7.png[/img]

[b]What were your first impressions after seeing the game and hearing the final dialogues?
[/b]
[b]V:[/b] I was so stoked about this trailer. I finally got to hear the other voices and it solidified what this world is, that I've been living in for the last year. The team explains it to me as much as possible, but it’s only after seeing and hearing it all that it finally clicked for me. And it absolutely met my expectations.

[b]A:[/b] I love indie games, it's where I find some of the coolest, most unique material. And with that, you don't always know how the final product is going to turn out. And the trailer really blew my mind, it’s incredibly gorgeous! The world is phenomenal and so detailed. The music gave me chills. To see how much was accomplished with just the trailer makes me really excited and intrigued for what’s next. It is way beyond what I expected.


[b]Did Yaga’s adventures leave any significant thoughts and emotions with you?[/b]

[b]A:[/b] I think it made me more empathetic. In BLACKTAIL, you see that anyone has the potential to make morally questionable decisions when they’ve been ostracised, rejected with no support. As an individual player, you are forced to make those decisions on your own. I hope it encourages people to understand that things are more complicated than they look, and you have to consider the consequences of being an outcast.

[b]V:[/b] It got me thinking a lot about what “happily ever after” means. At the end of a Disney movie, the villain is defeated, you’ve found your one true love, and anything bad that happened, doesn’t matter anymore because you're happy now. In BLACKTAIL no matter how you play, the ending doesn’t negate any of the characters’ actions or the gravity of what they went through. I think that's something very relatable, because we can have these happy or life-changing moments, but everything we have been through remains. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/c14fb1752b1c3dbb1dcfdeadd2c8a340c4416933.png[/img]

[b]As a player, would you choose to play the good witch or the bad witch?[/b]

[b]A:[/b] I have a history of always wanting to be good in video games. I stop at traffic lights in Grand Theft Auto. That is who I am. I would play BLACKTAIL as close to my actual self as possible. I’m not sure if I would turn out as good or bad, because of that morally grey area. I'll probably still stray to the side of good because I get so worried about hurting even fake people and fake creatures. But who knows?

[b]V:[/b] I'm probably around the same path as Avalon. I feel bad if I hurt a character in a game. So I would probably stray towards the good side, though there’s a couple of choices where I think that the bad side is justified. So I end up being somewhere in the middle, in that morally grey area… but I hope more good.

[previewyoutube=mGfUMV1Q1SI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Special thanks to Avalon Penrose, Valerie Rose Lohman and Nergal for taking the time to talk with us! BLACKTAIL releases December 15 on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532690/BLACKTAIL/]Steam[/url].[/b]

notes.title: The Skills a Witch Needs to Get Ahead
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We’ve shared quite a bit about the inspirations and history behind BLACKTAIL, but now let’s talk gameplay—namely the skills you’ll need to survive in the woods! Yaga, being a peasant girl, already knows quite a bit about hunting, trapping, starting fires, and the like, so the skills you’ll be focused on collecting fall more in Combat and Witchcraft categories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/495c6a4454c3703bef26e42ac547ea6bc9eb5595.gif[/img]

As you explore BLACKTAIL, you’ll discover all kinds of materials to hoard. Some, like feathers, herbs, and branches are common, but you’ll be using them frequently to craft arrows and other on-the-go items. Others, such as Spider’s Eyes are found far less frequently or are dropped by monsters roaming the woods. Even rarer items, such as teeth, can be discovered in hidden chests or in the lairs of very dangerous creatures. 

Finding the items to unlock new skills is just half the battle. You’ll also have to scour the world of BLACKTAIL for Lost Pages of the Hut’s book to discover recipes for the cauldron that allow you to craft elixirs and potions that expand your skills. Fair warning, these pages will be difficult to find and will often require feats of daring-do. 

In BLACKTAIL, your trusty bow goes a long way while on the outskirts of the forest but it alone won’t be enough once you start braving the deeper, darker woods. Combat oriented abilities range between passive upgrades that allow you to draw your bow faster, do more damage, and create special arrows. Active abilities will let you dash, deflect projectiles, and huff, puff, and blow enemies away. 

Well-trained witches can hex areas, buffing themselves and damaging or disabling surrounding foes. And what’s a witch without a potion or two? You’ll also be able to brew up concoctions that heal, cure poison, sharpen the senses, and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/439731df098d392b14492619e6e06e3be88469fa.gif[/img]

Sharp eyed fans may have noticed the small animal glyphs beside certain skills. We’ll have more to share about those soon, but in the meantime we’ll just say that they’re connected to the artfully-crafted 2.5D narrative episodes scattered throughout the world.

notes.title: It All Started With An Idea - THE PARASIGHT Turns Two
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/d09481cbcdec679ab01731a6965c043f71dcca81.jpg[/img]

Hi Everyone!
...or maybe I should start with “Good-day, Little Red-Cap”?

I’m Bartosz Kaproń, founder, Creative director, and CEO at THE PARASIGHT. Today is the 2nd birthday of our studio, so I thought I’d take this opportunity to introduce myself and share some of the ideas that serve as the foundation for our team’s vision. 

Once upon a time... in a deep, dark wood... THE PARASIGHT began as an idea. “What if we could breathe new life into folk and fairy  tales that, over time, have become legends —and give them a modern twist unlike what’s been seen before?” Two years after our founding, here we are… in a kingdom far, far away. We’ve quietly grown from an idea into a dedicated team in Krakow of more than 20 creative minds as well as working with a bunch of great people around the world. Many of us have been working together for years as we co-created titles like Layers of Fear and Observer together and I have to say throughout my career I’ve never been able to work with a team so excited to bring a story to life.

I grew up on great game series like Final Fantasy and Suikoden , with breaks for Magic:The Gathering with friends from the backyard, - and for some reason ended up as a hardcore Quake 2 and Starcraft player. And I love making games as much as I do playing them—especially true on narrative heavy projects where the story’s themes are reflected throughout. 

Myths, legends, and fairy tales are some of the oldest narratives known to humanity. These fairy tales speak to a place and time very long ago. How many of us ever wonder if these places and stories were real? As they have been handed down, they have been changed to fit local histories, a wide variety of religions, government propaganda, and creative retellings by musicians, writers, and storytellers of all kinds. We plan to take the stories we grew up with and challenge players’ expectations by combining classic fables with a surprising blend of aesthetics, designs and narratives. My heart always belongs to details and proportion. This comes back to my background in art, design, and production I suppose, so I want these values to show in everything THE PARASIGHT creates. 

You’ve already [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4sL4ZGedxhg]heard this[/url] in our musical taste and seen a little of how we plan to combine realistic and the surreal in-game. Clashing different ideas and styles against each other allow opposites to shine brighter than ever. 

Back in June, we announced our first title [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1_zlT1SB-sE]BLACKTAIL[/url]. The teaser opens on many things people already associate with the stories of Baba Yaga—the chicken leg hut, bubbling cauldron, black cat, and more. But also introduces doubt, do we really know the whole story about the person behind the legend? 

It was a beautiful day when we caught an idea called BLACKTAIL. We want you to come and dream with us—the choices you make will determine whether this story belongs in a heartwarming collection of fairy tales or a nightmare whispered after dark … or maybe everything was written in the stars anyway?

We have a lot to share about BLACKTAIL and I promise you it’s a treat worth waiting for. You know what they say: Baba Yaga never breaks a promise. Hearts - yes, but never a promise. So keep your eyes on our social channels, Discord, and Steam community hub for early looks at gameplay and lore. I hope you’ll join us for the adventure that lays ahead. 

This is not THE END,
Bartosz

notes.title: The Slavic Folklore That Inspired BLACKTAIL
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We’re working away at some new and nifty things we can show very soon! While we’re all waiting, let’s talk a little about why we’re so focused on the Slavic myths that inspire much of our game! 

Where Norse, Greek, and Roman mythology is known around the globe, the myths and ritual practices of the Slavs before Christianisation have slowly been vanishing. Many people can name deities such as Odin, Zeus, and Jupiter from these mythos, few know who Perun, Veles, and Dazhbog are. With exceptions, such as the stories of Baba Yaga, many of our legends have become less recognized fairy tales and bedtime stories that continue to be swept away by modern media and popular culture, even in our region in Europe. 

Stories are deeply connected to Slavic culture, language, and now… our games! We believe there is a massive amount of potential, hidden deep beneath the well-worn surface of our legends for inspiring new stories. We’ve seen this in how these stories have preserved over hundreds of years, some passed down from parent to child, others adapted into more Christian rites.  With THE PARASIGHT, our goal is to create games based on folk and fairy tales you may never have heard at home or taught in school. We want to give them a modern twist while reviving interest in the originals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/29f076630034c91bb82fba16e3186853be2f48eb.jpg[/img]

BLACKTAIL draws on all kinds of Slavic myth. From water spirits and shades such as the Rusalka and Vodnik, to the enigmatic Bobok, ambiguous gnome-like Krasnal and deceptive Ognik, up to fearsome basilisks and dragons, our stories are filled with dark, mysterious creatures. While some of these beings are benign (as long as they are not provoked or slighted) many monsters from our stories haunt dark woods and secluded ponds, just waiting for unwary travelers. We’re sure that fans of The Witcher series will know of many of the creatures you’ll see in BLACKTAIL and we plan to dig even deeper into the legends these beings come from to bring you interesting characters, immersive settings, and monstrous challenges. 

Watch out for more on monsters in the months to come! Got any favorite stories? Share them below and let us know what you like most about Slavic settings and folklore!

notes.title: BLACKTAIL has hit its Alpha milestone!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Exciting news! [b]BLACKTAIL[/b] has hit its Alpha milestone! 

What does this mean? Essentially, our dev team can now play the main storyline from end to end and many of [b]BLACKTAIL’s[/b] main gameplay features are now in place. This creates the foundation that we’ll be continuing to build on, but there’s still a long road to travel.  From here, we’ll be polishing and tuning content we want to keep, and adding new art, quests, characters, monsters, music (have you heard the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4sL4ZGedxhg]first[/url] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ABnobE7S8yI]tracks[/url] we’ve recently shared?), and everything else that makes a game. There’s lots to keep the team busy as we work towards Beta. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710835/88c78753c46ef12a0902eac2bb77fcf5da03d4a1.png[/img]

[b]BLACKTAIL[/b] is a full-fledged action-adventure game, so throughout development we’ll be constantly testing our archery combat, both in regular skirmishes and in big boss fights. We’ll be tweaking things like abilities, draw times, arrow range, hitmaps, and everything else to achieve the “easy to learn, hard to master” level of combat gameplay we’re aiming for.

notes.title: Get Down to THAT Witch House Soundtrack
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve hinted before about [b]contrast and duality[/b] being core themes in BLACKTAIL. Dark and light, past and present, myth and reality; these are the foundation of the design choices we’ve made (and are continuing to make) while developing this game. The music is no exception!

[previewyoutube=ABnobE7S8yI;full][/previewyoutube]
To help the soundtrack reflect these themes, we’ve teamed up with our [b]longtime composer partner Arkadiusz Reikowski[/b] on the project. He’s famous for his beautifully sinister work on games such as [b]The Medium[/b] (alongside Akira Yamoka), [b]Layers Of Fear 2[/b] (for which his work was nominated for Best Original Score - Video Game in the Hollywood Music In Media Awards), and [b]Blair Witch[/b]. We feel his expertise will bring an element of darkness to our musical vision for BLACKTAIL. 

[i]“BLACKTAIL is a unique production and a great challenge for me musically, but also a tremendous pleasure to work on. In BLACKTAIL, I’m using a combination of dreamlike, Slavic themes, and modern motifs that are unheard of, which allows us to create something truly unique, something that has not been previously seen in the video game industry. The effect will be more than worth the wait!”[/i] - says Arkadiusz Reikowski.

Arkadiusz will be working with, among others, the [b]Zazula Vocal Group[/b], [b]Bartosz Pałyga[/b], and [b]CZELUSC Collective[/b] on the BLACKTAIL soundtrack. 

[previewyoutube=4sL4ZGedxhg;full][/previewyoutube]
The first example of this partnership was teased in the [url=https://youtu.be/aRnh_ToN_5Y]announcement trailer[/url] (that BASS DROP!), but you’ll really be able to hear what we’re going for in the link above for the Summer season theme music remix (more on Seasons in the future!). Take a listen and let us know what you think! We hope you like it, as we’ll have plenty more for the game’s final release.

notes.title: Dive into our Fevered Fairytale Fantasy
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The [url=https://youtu.be/1_zlT1SB-sE]announcement trailer[/url] gave you all a taste of [b]BLACKTAIL[/b] and we’re sure you’re hungry to learn more! As we now have your curiosity, we’d love to tell you a bit more about the game! Let’s start with our vision of this unique world.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1532690/ss_9b6e518d9a6f28847996e0bfae36a314a5da42f3.jpg?t=1626420946[/img]

The best folk tales take elements from the world around us and make them larger than life. To capture this story of Baba Yaga, we’re [b]combining fairytale and reality into a surrealist dreamlike experience[/b] that drops players into a colorful, but deeply sinister region filled with forests, caves, hills, mountains, and more to explore. 

As [b]Yaga[/b], you’ll discover all kinds of new locations throughout with new challenges and enemies to match. Don't be deceived by the painted fairytale elements, these woods are still quite dangerous! Deadly enemies such as the wasps and gnomes, seen in the announcement trailer, lurk around every bend.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1532690/ss_5c78971d614b3893391179dadd3c7c236ae5ab29.jpg?t=1626420946[/img]

To build the world of BLACKTAIL, we’re [b]pushing the boundaries of Unreal Engine 4[/b] by mixing top-notch realistic visual assets created by our team of talented 3D artists with dreamlike, magical effects so that standout elements such as constellations, rivers, waterfalls, clouds, and the sun wrap the player in that [b]not-quite-real storybook feel[/b]. 

Blending realistic assets with fairy-tale graphical elements also reflects the greater [b]theme of duality[/b] in BLACKTAIL; clashing genres, good and evil, Slavic legends told through modern storytelling, and old folklore characters like Baba Yaga clash with original, twisted creatures.

Now, BLACKTAIL isn’t all gorgeously rendered 3D. As you explore, you’ll unlock [b]special 2.5D minigames that reveal character moments, story, and more[/b]. Our first example of this is the flaming goat .gif on the main store page. We have more exciting things to show about the use of 2.5D in the game, but that’s best saved for a later post!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40710835/f01c28fc6b46b0d13620a0481e568f6fe9266277.jpg[/img]

In the coming months we’ll continue to share more and more elements of the world, the gameplay, and the characters of BLACKTAIL. Follow our social media channels and stay tuned! 

[b]Got a question?[/b] Let us know in the comments, ask us on social media, or join our Discord! We’ll answer if we can, but if we can’t, we’ll hold on to your question for down the road.

notes.title: Welcome to BLACKTAIL! - Introduction and FAQs
notes.content:
So you watched the BLACKTAIL Trailer and now you’re here for more information about this wicked game… wait you didn’t watch it? 

Well we can fix that:
[previewyoutube=aRnh_ToN_5Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Now that you’re all caught up, let’s break down all the questions you may have!

[h3][b]Who are you people, and what are you doing in my house?[/b][/h3]
[url=https://theparasight.com/]We are THE PARASIGHT[/url]. We’re a team of experienced developers who have worked on some games you may have heard of: [i]Layers of Fear 1 and 2, Observer, Blair Witch, and The Medium. 
[/i]
As you can probably tell, we have a thing for surreal and haunting experiences with engaging narratives. We believe that story and mechanics work better in harmony with one another, and so we strive to achieve a perfect balance between gameplay and narrative in our games. BLACKTAIL is no exception!

[h3][b]What exactly is BLACKTAIL?[/b][/h3]
BLACKTAIL is a surreal, folklore inspired, narrative-driven, first person, open world, action adventure game with a morality system, bow combat, crafting, and 2.5D mini games. [i]*catches breath*[/i] Those were all the adjectives we could think of to describe the game. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AP8FLMF.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]What genre is BLACKTAIL?[/b][/h3]
Genres are a social construct. They aren’t real…

….okay fine, BLACKTAIL blends multiple genres into one! It is mainly a narrative focused action-adventure experience, but incorporates elements from RPG and open-world games as well.

[h3][b]Give me the game mash up version of BLACKTAIL.[/b][/h3]
The world of [i]The Witcher[/i] meets the narrative theme of [i]Hellblade[/i] meets the genre-mashup of [i]What Remains of Edith Finch[/i] meets the archery combat of [i]Far Cry[/i].

[h3][b]Tell me the story of the game.[/b][/h3]
Play as Yaga, a timid and misunderstood young girl accused of witchcraft and cast out from her village. Guided by a mysterious dark voice, you’ll take up a bow and unlock mystical powers on your journey to find your missing sister, and uncover the ancient mysteries of the forest. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7IILByb.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]What will I be doing in BLACKTAIL?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fight mystical creatures using your bow and magical gauntlet in dynamic combat. Some of those creatures will be bigger and more challenging; we call these ‘Bosses’, hoping it catches on.
[*] Craft potions for buffs and antidotes, a variety of arrow types with different effects, and brooms (more on those in the future).
[*] Complete a variety of side quests, with morally ambiguous choices that affect your abilities and change how you interact with the cast of colorful NPCs.
[*] Play surreal, retro inspired 2.5D mini games to uncover memories from Yaga’s past.
[/list]
[h3][b]Folklore you say? What kind of folklore?[/b][/h3]
The main inspiration for the BLACKTAIL’s lore comes from traditional Slavic folk tales and age-old legends passed down across generations. The dark story of Baba Yaga is one of them. A classic storybook illustration style also played a significant role in designing the game’s world and its inhabitants. 

[h3][b]What is a Baba Yaga?[/b][/h3]
You mean WHO is Baba Yaga. She is a supernatural being from Slavic folklore, and is most often depicted as a ferocious-looking old woman living in a hut that stands on a chicken leg [i](as you saw in the trailer!)[/i]. She is infamously known for being enigmatic and morally ambiguous; either helping or harming those that encounter her as she pleases.

[h3][b]What engine is the game being built in?[/b][/h3]
BLACKTAIL is being developed with all the bells and whistles of Unreal Engine 4. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vt1EEmU.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Where will I play BLACKTAIL?[/b][/h3]
The game will be releasing on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S

[h3][b]You said the game will be released this winter. When will we get an actual release date?[/b][/h3]
Let us keep SOME things a mystery! [i](we haven’t picked a specific date yet)[/i]

[h3][b]Is BLACKTAIL an Early Access game?[/b][/h3]
No, the game will be released as a complete and polished experience.  Patience is a virtue :).

[h3][b]What languages will the game be available in?[/b][/h3]
The audio of BLACKTAIL will be in English. The text and subtitles will be translated into Polish, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Chinese Simplified, Japanese, Russian, and Brazilian Portuguese.

[h3][b]That’s a wrap for now![/b] [/h3]
This was fun, we’ll do it again sometime. In the meantime,[b] [url=https://discord.gg/xCFFT4ddcr]jump into our Discord[/url][/b] to ask even MORE questions and get [i]mostly[/i] non-cryptic answers. We also encourage you to share pictures of your black cats, you know, because [i]witches[/i].
